categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Ailu Package Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial paper packaging, consumer paper packaging, plastic packaging, intelligent packaging systems, and high-performance photovoltaic component products. The company offers integrated soft packaging solutions covering research, design, production, sales, and services. It also has subsidiaries focusing on photovoltaic backsheet films and composite material frames.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including fully automated high-speed multilayer composite paper-plastic packaging bag production lines, printing machines, and blown film machines mainly sourced from Germany's W&H company. It employs intelligent manufacturing with digitalized production systems, including robotic automation for powder and granular material packaging. The company also develops innovative eco-friendly packaging such as the Espeed series of plastic-free paper-based packaging with heat-sealing capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span multiple industries including chemical, building materials, food and food additives, pharmaceuticals, and new energy sectors. Notable clients include global and domestic leaders such as Friesland Campina, Cargill, Nestle, Mengniu, Yili, BASF, Dow, and others. The company serves over 700 customers annually, including multinational corporations and leading domestic enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in domestic regions including East China, North China, South China, Northeast, Northwest, Central China, and Southwest. It also has a growing international presence with exports to countries such as Indonesia, the Philippines, Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, Japan, India, and New Zealand. Production bases are located in Shanghai and Jiangsu Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Ailu operates mainly in the midstream segment of the packaging supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying packaging materials and systems. It provides integrated packaging solutions from raw material processing to finished packaging products and intelligent packaging equipment, serving downstream industrial and consumer product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in green, sustainable, and intelligent packaging solutions, including the development of recyclable paper-based packaging and advanced composite materials for photovoltaic applications. R&D focuses on product performance optimization, new material development, and intelligent packaging systems. The company invests significantly in R&D, maintaining a robust technology center and pursuing certifications to support product quality and environmental goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of packaging products and intelligent packaging systems to industrial and consumer clients. The company operates on an order-based production model, providing customized packaging solutions. It also generates income from investments and government subsidies related to its manufacturing activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Ailu is positioned as a leading domestic provider of integrated soft packaging solutions with capabilities surpassing many competitors who offer only product-level services. It holds a competitive advantage through its comprehensive service offerings, advanced technology, and strong customer relationships with industry leaders. The company is recognized for its innovation and quality in the packaging industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.19 billion, representing an 11.63% increase from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 53.33 million, a decline of 29.16% due to early-stage investments in photovoltaic projects. Total assets reached RMB 2.93 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.53 billion, showing steady growth and expansion of production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Ailu differentiates itself by providing integrated, customized packaging solutions that optimize packaging processes and reduce overall costs for clients. Its products emphasize environmental sustainability, including recyclable and plastic-free packaging innovations. The company combines advanced manufacturing technology with strong R&D capabilities to deliver high-quality, reliable packaging materials and intelligent systems, meeting diverse industry needs.
